### EventType

EventType identifies the kind of workspace event sent via SSE.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `node_created` | EventNodeCreated is sent when a new node (page or table) is created. |
| `node_updated` | EventNodeUpdated is sent when a node's content or title changes. |
| `node_deleted` | EventNodeDeleted is sent when a node is removed. |
| `node_moved` | EventNodeMoved is sent when a node is moved to a new parent. |
| `records_changed` | EventRecordsChanged is sent when a table record is created, updated, or deleted. |
| `table_updated` | EventTableUpdated is sent when a table schema or view changes. |

### FilterOp

FilterOp defines the comparison operator for a filter.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `equals` | FilterOpEquals matches if value equals the filter value. |
| `not_equals` | FilterOpNotEquals matches if value does not equal the filter value. |
| `contains` | FilterOpContains matches if value contains the filter value (text). |
| `not_contains` | FilterOpNotContains matches if value does not contain the filter value. |
| `starts_with` | FilterOpStartsWith matches if value starts with the filter value. |
| `ends_with` | FilterOpEndsWith matches if value ends with the filter value. |
| `gt` | FilterOpGreaterThan matches if value is greater than the filter value. |
| `lt` | FilterOpLessThan matches if value is less than the filter value. |
| `gte` | FilterOpGreaterEqual matches if value is greater than or equal to the filter value. |
| `lte` | FilterOpLessEqual matches if value is less than or equal to the filter value. |
| `is_empty` | FilterOpIsEmpty matches if value is empty/null. |
| `is_not_empty` | FilterOpIsNotEmpty matches if value is not empty/null. |

### OrganizationRole

OrganizationRole defines the role of a user within an organization.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `org:owner` | OrgRoleOwner has full control including billing. |
| `org:admin` | OrgRoleAdmin can manage workspaces and members. |
| `org:member` | OrgRoleMember can only access granted workspaces. |

### PropertyType

PropertyType represents the type of a table property.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `text` | PropertyTypeText stores plain text values. |
| `number` | PropertyTypeNumber stores numeric values (integer or float). |
| `checkbox` | PropertyTypeCheckbox stores boolean values. |
| `date` | PropertyTypeDate stores ISO8601 date strings. |
| `select` | PropertyTypeSelect stores a single selection from predefined options. |
| `multi_select` | PropertyTypeMultiSelect stores multiple selections from predefined options. |
| `user` | PropertyTypeUser stores a reference to a workspace member by user ID. |
| `url` | PropertyTypeURL stores URLs with validation. |
| `email` | PropertyTypeEmail stores email addresses with validation. |
| `phone` | PropertyTypePhone stores phone numbers with validation. |

### SortDir

SortDir defines the sort direction.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `asc` | SortAsc sorts in ascending order (A-Z, 0-9, oldest-newest). |
| `desc` | SortDesc sorts in descending order (Z-A, 9-0, newest-oldest). |

### ViewType

ViewType defines the layout type for a view.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `table` | ViewTypeTable displays records in a spreadsheet-like table. |
| `board` | ViewTypeBoard displays records in a kanban board grouped by a property. |
| `gallery` | ViewTypeGallery displays records as cards in a grid. |
| `list` | ViewTypeList displays records in a simple list. |
| `calendar` | ViewTypeCalendar displays records on a calendar by date property. |

### WorkspaceRole

WorkspaceRole defines the permissions for a user within a workspace.

| Value | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ws:admin` | WSRoleAdmin has full workspace control. |
| `ws:editor` | WSRoleEditor can create and modify content. |
| `ws:viewer` | WSRoleViewer can only read content. |

### ResourceQuotas

ResourceQuotas defines per-workspace content limits shared by server, org, and workspace layers.
